theorem_title: Absolute bound for a local raw output key
formal_statement:
theorem ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.GlobalKeyEnumeration.rawOutput_abs_le {h L : ℕ} (w : _root_.ThreeSum.LocalHashMoments.Weight L (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LocalHashMoments.LocalField h))
    (Q : Finset (Fin L)) : |_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.GlobalEncoding.rawOutput w Q| ≤ ((L*_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LocalCoverBounds.localPrime h : ℕ) : ℤ) := by sorry
natural_language_statement:
For natural local size $h$, width $L$, local-field weight assignment $w$, and coordinate subset $Q\subseteq\{0,\ldots,L-1\}$, $$|\operatorname{rawOutput}(w,Q)|\le L\operatorname{localPrime}(h).$$

This bound places constructed local keys inside the finite word envelopes required by the actual key-building code.
